slots.role: Plant the topic with a typed query
slots.visualRecipe: White ground. Empty search bar at 16% of width growing to 30%. After typing, text alone at 22% of width, centred.
slots.motionRecipe: Bar grows slowly for 0.7 s. Characters at 2-3 frame intervals from 1.1 s. At 1.55 s, bar disappears and text scales 3.5x in 2 frames. Cursor blinks. Paper grain cuts in 3 frames before the end.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: very quiet; soft ticks of keys could fit. Measured level stays low until 4.2 s.

copySlot.purpose: The topic, as a search phrase

slots.visualRecipe: Eight real-looking pages of different types, each with the phrase in a yellow highlight at one fixed frame point.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cuts with 4, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 2, 3 frames. No motion within a page.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: a rising pulse or rapid ticks. Do not try to place a hit on each page.

copySlot.purpose: The same phrase highlighted on every page

slots.visualRecipe: Black ground, 9:16 clips with rounded corners at 18% of width, centred in a column.
slots.motionRecipe: Opens from a crop of lips in 6 frames. Holds 0.3 s. The column scrolls up smoothly to the next clip, slowing and shrinking.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: level rises at about 4.2 s; start this slot still quiet.

slots.visualRecipe: Wall of clips covering the frame, 6 columns growing to 16, vignette at the edges.
slots.motionRecipe: Neighbours arrive as soft white blocks and resolve outward from the centre in 0.4 s. Continuous pull-back to the end.
slots.soundRecipe: Measured in the reference audio: level lifts near 4.2 s, then an uneven swell figure repeats about every 3.7 s (+0, +0.7, +1.6, +3.0 s). Inferred: this is a rhythmic backing. Land main picture changes on its swells.

slots.visualRecipe: Previous wall at 25% brightness, then dim footage. Medium white sentence on one line, 45% of width, centred. Yellow pill on the figure. Small citation line at 80% height.
slots.motionRecipe: Wall dims in one frame. Words arrive 3-6 frames apart, yellow cooling to white in 9 frames, while the line stays centred. Background cuts every 2-3 frames for 0.5 s, then every 30-60. One grey frame at 7.3 s. Hold 0.8 s. Words delete in groups from the left; the rest hold position.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: swells carry it. Cut backgrounds to transients, not the words.

copySlot.purpose: A true, sourced figure about the problem

slots.visualRecipe: Same system. Pill first on the subject of the sentence, then jumps to the figure.
slots.motionRecipe: Pill snaps at 10.3 s. Hold. Middle words delete, background drops to black for 4 frames at the end.

copySlot.purpose: A true, sourced figure about the cost

slots.role: The largest figure over a picture of scale
slots.visualRecipe: A single wide shot of something huge at 30% brightness. Line and pill at the centre.
slots.motionRecipe: Pill with the figure arrives early, the rest around it. Almost no background cuts: this one is meant to sink in.
slots.soundRecipe: Measured in the reference audio: the cut in falls on a swell, within 0.05 s.

slots.role: Start the question, large then tiny
slots.visualRecipe: Black ground. Two large words at 64% of width in one lit colour. Then a tiny phrase at 16-20% of width.
slots.motionRecipe: Words track right to left for 1 s, in focus at the centre only. The tiny phrase hardly moves and holds for 0.7 s.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: pull back the level on the tiny phrase if the mix allows; data can't confirm this was done.

copySlot.purpose: First part of the question, then filler words

slots.visualRecipe: Accent colour with bloom on black, 83% of width on arrival.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cut in at 83% of width, shrinking to 72% while drifting left, then exits at the frame's edge.
slots.soundRecipe: Measured in the reference audio: the cut falls within 0.08 s of a swell. That it is the largest sound is not established.

slots.visualRecipe: White word with accent punctuation, 51% of width. Accent light grows in a corner.
slots.motionRecipe: Continues the rightward-to-left travel. Light grows from 16.5 s. Do not resolve: cut to what comes next.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: unresolved; the film has no end in this file.

rhythm.cutGrid: No regular cut grid. Main picture changes land on an uneven swell figure repeating about every 3.7 s; the tempo reading of 128 has low confidence (0.456). Three speeds: one long take, a burst at 2-4 frames a shot, one 4 s continuous move, reading-speed holds, then four word-shots. The contrast between speeds is the rhythm.

style: Starts as calm white web pages with a yellow highlighter, moves to real phone video, then to dim footage with small confident text, ending in large lit words on black.

keep: Query, proof, person, crowd, cost, question: this order
One fixed point through the smash cut
One short centred line over a dim changing picture
Every figure with a visible citation
Big word, tiny word, biggest word
mustChange: All copy and figures, which must be true, with their real citations
All graphics, pages and interface shown
All faces and clips: consented material only
All background footage, licensed by us
